checked.item: Layout & hierarchy: org switcher header, Administrative functions row, pinned rows directly below, 3px divider under the admin block, main nav, promo card
Administrative functions link opens the catalog (27 links, 8 groups)
Pinned row (Organizations, pinned by default) opens the list and stays highlighted on an org page
Unpin icon on a pinned row: shows on hover, removes the row at once, user stays on the page
Transactions accordion: expand, pick a subpage, collapse, auto-open on direct URL
Smart rules / Invoicing / Analytics chevrons: no expand (production stub, ignored per context)
State: 10 pins need a sidebar scroll at 1280x800 (decided cap)
Layout & hierarchy: H1, 8 group headings, 27 links with pin icons
Pin icon: hidden until row hover/focus when unpinned, filled and always visible when pinned
Pin click adds the page to the bottom of the sidebar at once; a second click unpins it
State: 10-pin cap shows an inline error next to the H1; other icons disabled with a not-allowed cursor and an 'Unpin a page to add another' tooltip (source)
'Current organization admin page' link opens the selected org's details
Opens with focus in search; empty field shows Recently viewed (5) + All organizations
Typing does not filter; Enter starts a search with a ~0.7s spinner; Enter is ignored while searching (source)
Second Enter on unchanged text selects the highlighted result; arrow keys move the highlight; clicking a row selects it
Select: dropdown closes, header updates, green toast, lands on Dashboard, Recently viewed updates
State: 'No organizations found' empty result
State: text edited after a search keeps the old results listed until the next Enter
Escape closes the dropdown
Search + Apply filter (other filters are mock, not exercised)
Row Select (sticky column): toast, lands on Dashboard, search kept, row shows grey 'Selected'
Org name link opens the Organization page
Select Organization: stays on the page, chip changes to Selected, green button hidden, toast, sidebar header updates
Edit / Archive / Delete / Send / Analyze: not wired (production, ignored)

findings.element: Org switcher, result list after the search text is edited
findings.finding: After the user edits the search text, the list keeps showing the previous query's results and highlights, so the list and the field no longer agree and nothing signals that the results are stale.
findings.user_impact: An agent switching orgs many times a day can click a stale row and land in the wrong customer's organization, or think the new query returned the old matches.
findings.suggested_fix: Clear or visibly dim the previous results as soon as the field text differs from the last searched query, so only a fresh Enter shows clickable results.

evidence.action: Search 'tea' and press Enter, then edit the text without pressing Enter again
evidence.observed: 'TE / Tea Leaf Collective' stays listed and clickable under the edited text until the next Enter starts a new search

gaps: Org switcher: Enter in an empty field was never exercised. The source (searched '' === query '') suggests it immediately selects the first Recently viewed org, which would be an accidental switch, but the state map does not record it.
Sidebar unpin: the focus target after unpin is cut off in the state map ('focus moves to '), so where the user lands after removing a row is unknown.

Sidebar to catalog sync: unpinning from the sidebar while the Administrative functions page is open was never exercised, so it is unknown whether the catalog pin icon (and the 10-pin cap state) updates live.
Pinned rows other than Organizations: active-row highlighting when on a pinned page such as Users or Health Hub is not recorded, so it is unknown whether the agent can see which pin they are on.

Pinned pages after an org switch: it is not recorded whether a pinned org-scoped page (e.g. Current organization admin page) reflects the newly selected org when opened from the sidebar right after switching, which is the core of the primary task.
